HashedFile.description:
A file a run read: the path it was given, and the SHA-256 of its bytes.

Attributes:
    path (str): The path as given on the command line, so a relative path
        stays relative and names no folder outside the project.
    sha256 (str): The SHA-256 of the file's bytes, as 64 lowercase hex
        digits, the form `sha256sum` prints.

path.description: The path as given on the command line.
path.title: Path

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the file's bytes, as `sha256sum` prints it.
sha256.title: Sha256

HashedFile.title: HashedFile

RunProvenance.description:
What a run read and where it ran, so a verdict can be traced to its inputs.

Git and GitHub keep who changed a rule and who approved a run. The hashes
and the commit here tie a verdict to them: a reviewer recomputes a hash, or
opens the commit, to check that the report judged what was approved. A field
stays empty when its source is missing, such as git outside a repository.

Attributes:
    veridelta_version (str): The Veridelta release that ran.
    started_at (datetime): When the run started, with its time zone.
    config_file (HashedFile | None): The configuration file, or None for a
        run of two files and `--key`.
    baseline_file (HashedFile | None): The `--baseline` file, or None.
    commit_sha (str | None): The commit checked out where the run started,
        or GitHub Actions' `GITHUB_SHA` without git.
    working_tree_clean (bool | None): Whether no tracked file differed from
        that commit, or None when git could not tell.
    ci_run_url (str | None): The GitHub Actions run, over https, or None
        outside one. It holds no space, quote, bracket, or parenthesis, so it
        links safely in Markdown and HTML.

description: The summary of a comparison: the row counts, the verdict, and the drifting columns.

total_mismatches.description:
Count added, removed, and changed rows together.

Returns:
    int: The total.
total_mismatches.title: Total Mismatches

mismatch_ratio.description:
Divide the mismatches by the source row count.

Returns:
    float: The ratio, which can exceed 1.
mismatch_ratio.title: Mismatch Ratio

match_rate_percentage.description:
Express the match rate as a percentage, never below zero.

The mismatch ratio counts added and removed rows over the source rows,
so it can pass 1 when most keys miss. The rate then stays at 0 and
the counts say how far apart the two sides are.

Returns:
    float: The percentage, rounded to two decimal places, such as `99.98`.
match_rate_percentage.title: Match Rate Percentage

is_perfect_match.description:
Return whether nothing mismatched under the configured rules.

Returns:
    bool: Whether `total_mismatches` is zero.
is_perfect_match.title: Is Perfect Match

volume_shift.description:
Subtract the source row count from the target's.

Returns:
    int: Target rows minus source rows.
volume_shift.title: Volume Shift

report_summary.description:
Format the counts and the most drifted columns as plain text for a CI log.

Returns:
    str: The report.
report_summary.title: Report Summary
